title: Viv's Vanilla Villagers
description: A texture pack that replaces villagers into dirt homunculi and illagers into stone homunculi!
body:
# Welcome to Viv's Vanilla Villagers!

Have you ever felt bad that the villagers you've put in a pen don't get to live out their dreams? Have you ever felt bad about destroying a pillager's home just to have that Bad Omen potion? 

Well, feel better, with this new texture pack! Each villager and pillager and golem have now been redone to become lore-united: all homunculi from a time long gone, animated to imitate the lives of their makers! Now powered by emeralds and breeding through compost! These villagers are found in different biomes each with thir own look and feel. 

TLDR: A texture pack that replaces villagers into dirt homunculi and illagers into stone homunculi! Even witches are now soulsand creatures! Now, we can stop feeling bad about putting them to labour camps!
(_This is my first texture pack. Comments are welcome!_)
